help_summary: Keep your program shortcuts together with names, descriptions and manuals so you remember what each one is.
help_howto:
• In Explorer, right-click > New > 'Shortcut list' to create a list, then double-click it to open. 'Shortcut list shortcut' keeps the list file in the program folder and creates a shortcut here whose icon you can change.
• Click + or drop shortcuts and programs onto the window to add them. Dropping several at once adds them all by name without a dialog.
• Double-click a row or press Enter to run it. Use the pencil button (or the edit shortcut key) to edit or delete.
• Rows with a manual, web address or memo show an icon on the right.
• Choose custom order in the sort menu to drag the handle on the left and reorder.
• Set another list (.sbook) as a target to nest lists like folders. Mouse button 4 / Backspace / Left arrow goes back, button 5 / Right arrow goes forward.
• Select several rows with Shift / Ctrl to run, delete, move to top or drag them together.
• Drag the handle onto the middle of another list's row, or onto another window, to move the item into that list.
• In the edit window, Ctrl+Enter saves and closes right away. You can scroll with the mouse wheel while dragging a handle.
